The '''Cathis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Cathis Rebel starfighter base]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
